I'm Aman. I write about AI agents, Large Language Models, and building autonomous systems that actually work in production (yes, they exist).

Previously, I led data science at REA Group, building property valuation models for 12.2 million Australian homes. This blog reaches over 200,000 readers annually across 131 countries.
